run_mae_inference: run MAE masked image modeling inference on input images to get reconstructed predictions
run_mae_visualization: run MAE inference with forward pass to visualize masked and reconstructed images side by side
build_mae_preprocess_pipeline: build a preprocessing pipeline that loads images and applies test transforms for MAE inference
list_mae_models: list all available MAE model names with optional wildcard pattern filtering
init_mae_test_pipeline: initialize the MAE test dataloader pipeline by removing LoadImageFromFile transform
